answer: Unrepeatable challenge lineage. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from a hidden grove of seed values committed per epoch. Answers are scored against a pigment-tagged difficulty target unique to that seed, so copying a valid answer from another identity fails the target check. A raven process audits lineage trees and flags any shared seed ancestry. Attacker cost: one full compute pass per identity per epoch, plus seed-acquisition work that scales linearly with fake identities.
